text.card: A red giant 3,741 parsecs away, 14 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 0.87 solar masses and 14.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,510 K at its surface.
